name: QuALITY
description: QuALITY (Question Answering with Long Input Texts, Yes!) is a multiple-choice QA benchmark with questions over long documents (averaging ~5,000 tokens). Questions were written by authors who read the full document, ensuring they require understanding of long-range dependencies. Includes hard questions that are difficult even for humans with access to the document.
reputation: Standard long-document multiple-choice QA; introduced at NAACL 2022; part of SCROLLS benchmark suite; tests understanding of documents too long for standard models
notes: Introduced at NAACL 2022. Articles from Project Gutenberg (fiction) and ANTH (science). Average document ~5,000 tokens, max ~9,000. A subset of 'hard' questions (those where speedreaders had below-chance accuracy) is tracked separately. Questions often require evidence from multiple parts of the document. Part of SCROLLS benchmark suite.
